header:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: finished App Store iOS 27 product page header for YamabikoChat, landscape 3840 x 1646 px, opaque PNG.
Primary request: Art-direct a highly crafted Swiss International Typographic Style + contemporary editorial design campaign about dialogue with multiple AI models. Use restrained charcoal, warm ivory and a small burnt orange accent, matching the existing app icon's palette.
Style/medium: Flat photographed cut-paper editorial artwork with extremely subtle tactile surface; rigorous asymmetric modular grid; precision grotesk typography. This is a finished graphic design artwork, not a mockup photograph of a poster.
Composition: Expansive charcoal field. Keep all essential artwork and text in central 70% width and central 70% height, outer edges quiet for App Store cropping. On left-center put exact wordmark "YamabikoChat" on two lines: "Yamabiko" and "Chat", in very large warm ivory Helvetica-like grotesk, carefully kerned, flush left. One tiny burnt-orange square aligns to the grid. On right-center two oversized cream paper speech silhouettes interlock in conversation, their tails articulate two opposing voices; one narrow orange reply silhouette bridges them. Restrained, intentional shadows as actual paper thickness, not glossy 3D. Different scale, impeccable geometry, plenty of negative space, purposeful editorial rhythm.
Text (verbatim): "Yamabiko" and "Chat". No other text.
Constraints: No fake app UI, no device, no humans, no claims, no pricing, no URLs, no other company's logos. No gradients, neon, glass, floating cards, metallic objects, sparkles, blue-purple tech aesthetic, stock illustration, robot, circuit patterns. Must look like a bespoke identity campaign from a professional editorial design studio. Clean full-bleed finished image, no borders or watermarks.
